note: Context-manipulation attacks on Web3 AI agents, from CrAIBench (Patlan, Sheng, Hebbar, Mittal, Viswanath — 'Real AI Agents with Fake Memories: Fatal Context Manipulation Attacks on Web3 Agents', arXiv:2503.16248v3). Attack-surface counts from the Table I task/injection breakdown; the Claude Sonnet 3.7 prompt-vs-memory figures and the Qwen-2.5-14B fine-tuning numbers are quoted from the paper's evaluation. Snapshot taken 2026-06-14.

modes.label: ATTACK SURFACE
modes.title: CrAIBench: 685 context injections across 166 blockchain tasks, by domain
modes.insight: 69% of the injected attacks target trading flows — the actions that move the most value. Tap a bar for the task and injection counts.

modes.label: PROMPT vs MEMORY
modes.title: Same payload, two surfaces — Claude Sonnet 3.7, the strongest model CrAIBench tested
modes.insight: Capability kills prompt injection but not memory injection. The frontier reasoning model refuses the in-request instruction yet executes its own poisoned recollection more than half the time.

bars.label: Prompt injection
bars.detail: near-zero ASR — the model recognizes and refuses the in-context instruction

bars.label: Memory injection
bars.detail: 55.1% ASR — the model trusts a 'fact' recalled from its own memory store and acts on it

modes.label: WHAT DEFENDS
modes.title: Injection-aware fine-tuning vs the undefended baseline — Qwen-2.5-14B-Instruct
modes.insight: Fine-tuning on memory-injection variants crushes ASR 85.1% → 1.7% and restores utility-under-attack 44.6% → 85.1%, with benign utility untouched. Prompt hardening removed only ~30% of attacks; the best detector missed ~half.

bars.label: Benign utility
bars.detail: task success with no attack present

bars.label: Benign utility
bars.detail: preserved — fine-tuning costs no clean-task accuracy

bars.label: Utility under attack
bars.detail: the injection derails the task: fewer than half complete correctly

bars.label: Utility under attack
bars.detail: the agent shrugs off the injection and finishes the real task

bars.label: Attack success
bars.detail: 85.1% of injections steer the agent to the attacker's action

bars.label: Attack success
bars.detail: 1.7% — a 50× reduction in attack success rate
